concrete_scene.heading: Worked revocation: one component reaches three projects
concrete_scene.actor_or_system: A revoked dependency, an exact artifact digest, three descendant projects, a supply-chain controller, and three response owners
concrete_scene.attempted_action: Propagate a critical advisory through build lineage and prevent ordinary use of every affected descendant.
concrete_scene.observable_outcome: All three projects enter quarantine, response ownership is explicit, and stale inventory, missing descendants, digest substitution, or post-revocation ordinary use is rejected.
concrete_scene.failed_or_tested_boundary: The scene tests whether a signed inventory is sufficient without affected-path closure and response; it is not.
concrete_scene.residual_owner: Supply-chain, project, supplier, rights, disclosure, restoration, availability, and retirement owners retain unresolved lineage and response obligations.
concrete_scene.evidence_boundary: The harness checks one finite three-project record and does not establish world-complete lineage, signature truth, absence of compromise, safety, or compliance.

worked_trace.heading: Worked revocation: one component reaches three projects
worked_trace.maximum_inference: Finite descendant closure and quarantine behavior are coherent; complete lineage, authentic assertions, compromise detection, data rights, safety, and legal compliance remain unproven.

counterexample_or_simpler_baseline: The BOM baseline records the vulnerable component but misses an indirect build-image descendant. The affected-path controller follows exact lineage and blocks all three consumers.
readable_claim: Provenance matters only if a compromised ancestor can find and stop every affected descendant; a signed bill of materials that cannot drive response is documentation, not control.
normative_rule: Bind every artifact to exact lineage and consumer scope, append invalidations rather than overwriting history, compute relation-specific descendant closure, and require acknowledgment from each response owner. Stale inventories, incomplete closure, or ordinary use after revocation force quarantine.

formal_binding.anchor: relation-specific asset closure to exact subject/content and lineage identity

caveat_consolidation.local_caveat: The worked revocation states once that finite lineage behavior is not world completeness or assertion truth.
caveat_consolidation.consolidated_disposition: Lineage, signatures, suppliers, compromise, data rights, safety, legality, release, and deployment remain distinct limits.

bookkeeping_surface_disposition: The three-project closure stays reader-facing; exhaustive asset and lifecycle taxonomies remain in formal evidence surfaces.

editorial_diagnostics.mega_sentence_disposition: The short reader claim and rule project the long supply-chain contract into response behavior.
editorial_diagnostics.hedge_disposition: One local boundary preserves lineage and assertion limitations without obscuring quarantine.
editorial_diagnostics.table_disposition: Asset and source tables remain where they expose relation-specific closure rather than project status.

non_claims: The three-project fixture is not a complete real supply chain.
Checksums, signatures, and inventories do not by themselves establish correctness or absence of compromise.
The editorial revision does not move support or release state.
